title: Clifton Cultural Arts Center (CCAC)

services.name: The Golden Ticket
services.desc: CCAC’s annual Golden Ticket Juried Art exhibition, presented by Summerfair Cincinnati, showcases diverse, talented artists living or working within a 50-mile radius of the Clifton Cultural Arts Center. Over $2,000 in prizes will be awarded for Best in Show (for whom CCAC will also host a solo exhibition), second and third place, and honorable mention. We’re also offering a brand new award to outstanding works in the installation art category. We’re introducing a new $500 Installation Award to celebrate ambitious, site-responsive work that engages the architecture of CCAC in unexpected ways. Rather than limiting artwork to the gallery walls, we invite artists to consider the entire building

blurb: CCAC is your community hub for discovery, expression, belonging, and connection - an inclusive, uplifting place where people from all walks of life come to learn, to share, to create, and to inspire.
